info.title: BuddyNext REST API
info.description: The public REST surface of the BuddyNext community plugin (Free), under the `buddynext/v1` namespace. This file is generated from the live route registry by `bin/gen-openapi.php`; do not hand-edit it. The hand-written narrative reference lives in `docs/website/developer-guide/` (pages 14-24). Pro adds its own `buddynext-pro/v1` namespace, which this document intentionally excludes.

servers.description: Replace example.com with the site host. The base path is the site's REST root plus the buddynext/v1 namespace.

token.description: Verification token from the emailed link.

parameters.description: Comma-separated post IDs to fetch the viewer's reaction/bookmark/vote state for.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions. `members` returns hydrated member objects (avatar, handle, headline, follow state) alongside the ids, in one batched call.

parameters.description: Rows per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-based.

parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions. `members` (the default) returns a `members` array of hydrated rows (display_name, avatar_url, profile_url, is_online, …) alongside `ids`. Pass an empty value for ids only.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response. Preferred over offset: it does not degrade as the list grows, and it cannot skip or repeat a row when new notifications arrive mid-page.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Notifications per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Row offset. Superseded by cursor for new clients.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return only notifications created AFTER this time. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (pass back created_at_gmt from a previous response) or a Unix epoch. Composes with cursor/per_page, so a large delta still pages.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-based.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions. `members` (the default) returns a `members` array of hydrated rows (display_name, avatar_url, profile_url, is_online, …) alongside `ids`. Pass an empty value for ids only.

type.description: Post type slug (text, photo, poll, link, announcement, …).

space_id.description: Target space ID; 0 or omitted posts to the global feed.

poll_end_date.description: Poll close datetime, UTC Y-m-d H:i:s (type=poll).

content_warning.description: Whether the post carries a content warning.

scheduled_at.description: Future publish datetime, UTC Y-m-d H:i:s (requires schedule-post capability).

announcement_expires_at.description: Announcement auto-expire datetime, UTC Y-m-d H:i:s (type=announcement).

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated expansions. `members` hydrates user results into full member objects (avatar, handle, headline, follow/connection state) instead of bare index rows.

parameters.name: tier_slug
parameters.description: Pro: filter members to an active subscription tier slug.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Restrict results to one space. On a member search (Pro) this means active members of the space; on any other type it means content posted in it.

parameters.name: member_label
parameters.description: Pro: filter members assigned this label slug.

parameters.name: joined_after
parameters.description: Pro: filter members whose registration date is on or after this ISO date (Y-m-d).

parameters.name: active_within_days
parameters.description: Pro: filter members active within the last N days (1-365).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter members by name or username (partial match).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Filter members by location (partial match).

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Filter members by skills (partial match).

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Return only members of this space ID.

parameters.name: connection_status
parameters.description: connections = only viewer's accepted connections; everyone = all members (default).

parameters.name: online_only
parameters.description: When true, return only members active in the last 5 minutes.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: newest, alphabetical, most_active, or online.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial query for as-you-type suggestions.

parameters.name: per_group
parameters.description: Max suggestions per type group.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Spaces per page.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number.

parameters.name: paginate
parameters.description: Set to 1/true/yes to wrap rows with total + total_pages. Ignored on the search path -- see list_spaces().

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: member_count | name | created_at, or an alias: popular, active, newest, alphabetical. NOTE: active is an alias for member_count, not recency.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: ASC or DESC.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Space type slug. Registry-driven, so custom types are accepted.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Filter by space category.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search. Takes precedence over q.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Alias for search.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: 1/true/yes to scope to spaces the viewer belongs to.

parameters.name: membership
parameters.description: manage = owned/moderated, joined = plain membership. Implies the member scope.

parameters.name: include_subspaces
parameters.description: 1/true/yes to include sub-spaces in the listing.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response.

parameters.description: Items per page (1-50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of media-bearing posts.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Media-bearing posts per page. Each post may carry several attachments.

note.description: Optional message included with the connection request (capped at 280 characters).

cookieAuth.name: X-WP-Nonce
cookieAuth.description: Logged-in browser clients send the WordPress auth cookies plus an X-WP-Nonce header (nonce for the wp_rest action).

appPassword.description: Non-browser clients (the native app, integrations) authenticate with a WordPress Application Password over HTTP Basic.
